anomalies.observed: R60 pin 2 is on ESTOP_OUT, the same net as D30 pin 4 (A2), so the LED's anode and the far end of its series resistor both sit on ESTOP_OUT. The LED is effectively in parallel with R60 across one net and can never conduct. By contrast, the companion LED channel D30 K1 returns through R59 to GND.
anomalies.expected: The second LED channel should return through R60 to GND, mirroring R59 on K1, so the indicator can light. Both ends of the series path should not sit on the same net.
anomalies.impact: The ESTOP_OUT indicator LED never lights, so the e-stop status indication is lost. The e-stop signal path itself is unaffected.

anomalies.observed: Q1 (P-MOSFET) has its source (pin 2) on +5V and its drain (pin 3) on USBC_VBUS_IN. The LTC4412 VIN pin (U6.1) is on USBC_VBUS_IN and SENSE (U6.6) is on +5V. This reverses the usual ideal-diode orientation, in which the PMOS source follows VIN and the drain feeds the load.
anomalies.expected: For an LTC4412 ideal-diode OR-ing path from USB VBUS to +5V, the PMOS source should be on the VIN (USB) side and the drain on the load side. Its body diode should conduct from VBUS toward +5V and block back-feed.
anomalies.impact: The body diode of Q1 may conduct backwards from +5V into the USB input. This defeats the reverse-current protection that the USB ideal-diode path is meant to provide.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k", but its library description and MPN (FRC0805J240TSD, "24Ω" in the description) indicate a 24 Ω part.
anomalies.expected: The value field should match the part actually specified, 24 Ω, or the MPN and description should be corrected to 24 kΩ.

evidence.quote: (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the board is built with the 24 Ω part, the resistor would load the VOUTP/VOUTN rail very heavily, instead of providing the intended high-value bleed.

parsed.summary: Most of the design looks internally consistent, but I found a few localized inconsistencies. The most clearly wrong is R60 returning to ESTOP_OUT instead of GND, which leaves an indicator LED unable to conduct. The Q1 source/drain orientation and the R36 value/part mismatch are lower-confidence findings.
